# Card AI

> Card AI is a trading card scanner and collection management app that helps collectors identify cards, track market prices, and understand their collection value.

The [canonical website](https://tcgcard.fun/) is tcgcard.fun. Card AI supports collectors across Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, and Digimon.

## Core Capabilities

- AI-assisted card scanning and identification
- Market price tracking and card-level market data
- Portfolio organization and collection value tracking
- Wishlist management
- Multi-game collection support
